description: Api-center public API contract — thay đổi ở đây trigger dependent module tests

metrics_report.notes: loss_pct: integer 0-100, nullable — packet loss percentage added v1.1

schema.stats: array<{region, avg_ms, min_ms, max_ms, samples, ok_rate, last_seen}>

metrics_derp_stats.notes: DERP RTT aggregation per region, last 1 hour from latency_samples

client_config.notes: Centralized config from client_config table — client fetches on startup to override local BAT values

client_proxy_pac.notes: Dynamic PAC file generated from client_config (lan_routes + pac_extra_subnets + pac_extra_domains). Browser points here instead of static .pac file. Admin changes take effect without modifying client files.

breaking_change_rules: derpmap schema change → must test derp-controller integration
metrics_report schema change → must test client-mod + derp-relay
internal_derp_map change → must test derp-controller Feature B
client_config schema change → must test client-mod start-tailscale.bat fetch block
client_proxy_pac change → must validate browser PAC routing for 10.x + 172.x + 192.168.x
